rows.name: pn-records
rows.responsibility: Immutable public inputs: identities, acts, typed opaque commitment residues, ledger/burn data and declared constants

rows.name: pn-act-profile
rows.responsibility: Shared pure act profile, canonical commitment recipes and supplied-opening comparison; no host or authentication dependency

rows.name: pn-act-authentication
rows.responsibility: Public token recipes, canonical authentication values, role-specific messages and candidate fixed-message verification operations; no complete act or chain verdict

rows.name: pn-graph
rows.responsibility: Structural formation, shared graph algebra and title folds

rows.name: pn-epoch
rows.responsibility: Compile and certify one final epoch state and its admission result

rows.name: pn-readouts
rows.responsibility: Expose published standing/title and optional exact raw views to terminal consumers

rows.name: pn-host
rows.responsibility: Encode the complete seven-part public package

rows.responsibility: Reconstruct and compare the binding package from public inputs

rows.name: pn-verification
rows.responsibility: Maintain labelled integrated fixtures and independent public-surface checks
